answer: Twenty tides open per epoch, each a gauge on a ledge, a marble in velvet. Claimants file tide readings chained to the last, signed by three strangers. The glacier shifts a meter per epoch; readings must match the tide table — a repeat, or two marbles, one height, freezes both. Entry locks 80 POA, +40 per extra fake per root: ten lock 2,600 POA. One operator tends two gauges max: ten fakes need five hands, ten readings, thirty signatures, fifteen strangers. Missed tides burn 25; one marble, two heights, void both. The gauges stand in a grove; ledger checks roots: ten tides, one root, one claim.
